purpose: Clean prospective validation of own-model challenger; external Delta benchmark is observed only after local weekly state and result are sealed.
thursday_signal_gate: Use only information demonstrably available by Thursday UTC close.

After Thursday UTC close and before Friday UTC close, seal raw-source hashes, CMC snapshot identifier/availability timestamp, panel hash, model/refit-state hash, all eligible scores, deterministic full ranking and preliminary top-10 longs.
The top-10 longs must equal the first 10 assets in the sealed score ranking.
No external Delta print/result may be inspected for model modification before sealing.
If CMC snapshot availability time is ambiguous, use the latest strictly-prior snapshot; never assume same-day month-end availability.
friday_pre_entry_gate: Before Friday UTC close, reference the exact signal seal hash.
Verify selected longs have predeclared executable instruments; unavailable selected long blocks the week rather than being replaced.
Verify shorts in frozen bottom-up score-rank order using causal read-only Binance USD-M evidence.
Select exactly the first 10 verifiably shortable assets encountered and stop checking when the 10th is found; no discretionary replacement.
Seal final 10 longs, 10 shorts, instruments, exposure, trailing volatility, turnover estimate, frozen 15 bps cost model and source coverage before Friday close.
Archive-based shortability may later corroborate the live seal but may not retroactively manufacture eligibility.
during_week: Record realized funding for each selected short with portfolio weight 0.05*exposure.
Record any delisting, contract suspension, missing source or execution anomaly as an explicit event; fail closed where required.
friday_exit_gate: Only after the following Friday UTC close, reference the exact entry seal hash and seal the weekly result.
Persist execution/source hashes and per-asset entry price, exit price, raw return, frozen weight and weighted PnL for exactly the 20 sealed holdings.
Recompute gross long PnL, gross short PnL, actual funding, 15 bps turnover cost, total net PnL and BTC benchmark return from sealed components.
Never backfill a blocked prospective week as valid evidence.
benchmark_comparison_gate: Only after V16B_RESULT_SEAL may a new external Delta checkpoint be attached.
The Delta attachment references the result seal hash and cannot replace any prior self evidence.
External Delta trajectory is benchmark evidence only, not a tuning input.
promotion_minimum: No promotion based on a single week or the historical 11-week reference print. Require months of sealed prospective observations plus stability/cost/source review.
